pages.raw_meta: HealthEquity is dedicated to helping Americans thrive in today's healthcare system by empowering health savings.
raw_blocks: We don't just administer benefits—we change people's lives.
Since our founding in 2002, HealthEquity has remained laser-focused on our mission to save and improve lives by empowering healthcare consumers.
By 2030, we plan to make HSAs more common than 401(k)s.
Easy-to-use benefits give members the tools and resources they need to spend smarter, save more and invest in their healthcare.
Our Total Solution delivers a powerful lineup of integrated benefits, helping employers offer a better experience at much lower cost.
Customized solutions and original thought leadership let benefits advisors strengthen relationships while offering a unique benefits package.
Powerful integrations with health plans, retirement providers, and TPAs simplify claims processing and enable clients to offer a more rewarding member experience.
Ongoing enhancements to the client and member experience continue to simplify benefits for millions.
Founder Steve Neeleman sets out to connect health and wealth for Americans struggling to manage healthcare costs. HIPAA passes, paving the way for widespread medical savings accounts.
The power of health savings
Our Mission HSA-centricity Total Solution
We're passionate about our mission.
Our mission is to save and improve lives by empowering healthcare consumers.

Purple isn't just our brand color. It's a way of life. It's the remarkable service we're known for. It's the magic we scale to millions of members nationwide. Combining our values, culture, and passion, it drives everything we do.
Work with us and you'll discover a remarkable experience brought to you by remarkable people.

Our differences strengthen our purpose, empowering us to make a concrete impact on the communities and people we serve. In 2015, we launched Purple with Purpose to support organizations that align with our mission to connect health and wealth.

At HealthEquity, we believe that every step forward begins with truly understanding our members, creating solutions that simplify healthcare benefits and deliver real, personal value. Our commitment to empowering healthcare consumers has earned us industry recognition and numerous awards.

We own our platform with full control over deployment and optimizations. This means a customizable experience for you.

Is an HSA right for our employees?
Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) are an increasingly popular way for employers to offer a comprehensive employee benefits package. With an HSA plan, employers benefit in several ways:
Selecting a High Deductible Health Plan paired with an HSA plan can significantly reduce healthcare spending for employers, offering a financially savvy solution.

With our HSA educational resources, you can boost employee empowerment and engagement surrounding their healthcare decisions. This can lead to healthier lifestyle choices and ultimately, lower medical costs for employers.
An HSA offers more flexibility than other employee benefits packages, allowing employees to choose how and when to spend their HSA funds.

Streamline workflows using no-cost integrations with your health plan, retirement provider, and payroll administrator.
Easily transfer member files from any platform or payroll vendor. Plus, we’ll execute bulk transfers automatically.

Stay apprised of upcoming regulatory changes and get timely updates to help ensure compliance. We’re in constant contact with state and federal decision makers.
